In-scope systems.value: NAIC iSite+/Financial Data Repository for statement upload; state DOI portals and OPTins for fee payment; RegData for the UK FCA return

Compliance procedure documented.value: Statutory Filing Procedure — data pull, blank population, actuarial/CFO review, submission, fee payment, confirmation retention

Compliance procedure approved.value: Approved by Controller and Chief Financial Officer; reviewed annually ahead of the March 1 Annual Statement cycle

Deadline reminders configured.value: Filing tracker alerts at T-30/T-14/T-3 days for every statement and supplemental due date

checklist.step: Set up the filing period and confirm the statutory basis
actions: Open the group filing calendar and confirm which NAIC-licensed writing entities and states are in scope for the quarter/annual cycle.

Confirm the accounting basis (Statutory Accounting Principles per the NAIC Accounting Practices & Procedures Manual) and the applicable Annual Statement blank (Life, Property/Casualty, or Health) for each entity.
Note each entity's NAIC company code and confirm it against the NAIC company database.
Flag any newly licensed or withdrawn state since the last cycle and update the in-scope list.
checklist.done: the in-scope entity/state list, blank type and NAIC company codes are confirmed for the period.

checklist.step: Pull the statutory trial balance and adjustments from the general ledger
actions: In the general ledger, run the statutory trial balance for the entity and period-end date.
Apply SAP-basis adjusting entries (non-admitted assets, statutory reserve adjustments) per the close checklist.
Reconcile the statutory trial balance total to the GAAP trial balance and document reconciling items.
Export the tied-out trial balance into the statement preparation workbook.
checklist.done: the statutory trial balance ties to the general ledger and reconciling items to GAAP are documented.

checklist.step: Populate the NAIC Annual/Quarterly Statement blank
actions: In the statutory reporting system, open the current-period Annual or Quarterly Statement blank for the entity.
Map trial balance accounts to the Assets, Liabilities/Surplus, and Summary of Operations pages per the NAIC crosswalk.
Complete the Jurat page with the entity's officers, NAIC company code and state of domicile.
Run the built-in edit checks (cross-foot, cross-page tie) and clear every flagged edit failure before proceeding.
checklist.done: the blank is fully populated, edit checks are clear, and totals cross-foot across pages.

checklist.step: Complete state-specific supplemental filings and addenda
actions: Check each in-scope state's supplement list (state page, premium tax reconciliation, guaranty fund assessment worksheet) against the state DOI's current filing checklist.
Populate each state-specific form using the same tied-out data source as the main blank.
Where a state requires a unique transmittal letter or affidavit, prepare it with the entity's authorized signatory.
checklist.done: every in-scope state's supplemental forms are complete and sourced from the same tied-out data.

checklist.step: Route the reserve and actuarial schedules to the Appointed Actuary
actions: Review the completed loss/claim reserve schedules and the Statement of Actuarial Opinion inputs against the reserving system output.
Confirm the reserve figures on the blank match the actuarial workpapers to the dollar.
Sign and date the actuarial review note attached to the filing package.
checklist.done: the Appointed Actuary has confirmed reserve figures tie to the actuarial workpapers and signed the review note.

checklist.step: Perform the management review of the completed statement
actions: Review the completed blank end-to-end against the prior period for unexplained variances greater than 5%.
Confirm every state supplemental form is attached and internally consistent with the main blank.
Document review comments and confirm resolution before sign-off.
checklist.done: the Controller has reviewed the package, resolved variance questions, and documented the review.

checklist.step: Obtain CFO certification
actions: Review the Controller's sign-off package and the Jurat page representations.
Certify the statement is complete and accurate to the best of the officer's knowledge, per the Jurat requirements.
Sign the Jurat page (wet or e-signature per state acceptance) before submission.
checklist.done: the CFO has certified and signed the Jurat page for every entity in scope.

checklist.step: Submit the statement to the NAIC and each state DOI
actions: In the NAIC statutory filing system, upload the electronic filing (.DAT) and PDF copy of the Annual/Quarterly Statement to the NAIC Financial Data Repository.
Submit the same package to the state of domicile and, where required individually, to each non-domiciliary in-scope state's DOI portal.
Record the submission timestamp and system-generated confirmation number for each destination.
checklist.done: the statement is submitted to the NAIC and every in-scope state, with a confirmation number recorded for each.

checklist.step: Pay filing fees and confirm payment posting
actions: Determine the filing fee for each state from the state DOI fee schedule.
Submit payment through OPTins or the state's own payment portal, referencing the correct entity and NAIC company code.
Save the payment confirmation and match it against the corresponding filing submission.
checklist.done: filing fees for every in-scope state are paid and matched to the correct submission.

checklist.step: Download and file every submission confirmation
actions: Download the NAIC and each state DOI's stamped acknowledgement or confirmation receipt.
Name each file <entity>-<state>-<period>-confirmation.pdf and upload it to the compliance evidence repository.
Cross-reference the confirmation numbers to the filing tracker entry.
checklist.done: a stamped confirmation is filed and cross-referenced for every state submission.

checklist.step: Track outstanding acknowledgements and resolve rejections
actions: Two business days after submission, check each state DOI portal for acceptance status.
For any rejection, read the rejection reason, correct the filing, and resubmit within the state's cure window.
Log any unresolved rejection as an exception in the regulatory filing/issue tracker with an owner and target date.
checklist.done: every submission shows Accepted status or has a logged, owned exception with a target resolution date.

checklist.step: File amendments before the amendment deadline
actions: Where a data error is found post-submission, prepare an amended Jurat page and the corrected schedule pages.
Route the amendment through the same CFO certification and Controller review steps as the original filing.
Submit the amendment to the NAIC and affected states and record the new confirmation number.
checklist.done: any required amendment is prepared, re-certified and submitted with its own confirmation number on file.

checklist.step: Update the filing calendar with actual dates and set the next-period reminders
actions: Record the actual submission date against the planned due date for each entity/state in the filing calendar.
Set T-30/T-14/T-3 day reminders ahead of the next Quarterly or Annual Statement due date.
Note any state-specific due-date change published by the NAIC or state DOI for the coming cycle.
checklist.done: the filing calendar reflects actual submission dates and reminders are armed for the next cycle.

checklist.step: Coordinate the parallel FCA RegData submission for the UK entity
actions: Confirm the UK entity's FCA integrated regulatory return schedule under SUP 16 against the group filing calendar.
Submit the corresponding financial, complaints and product sales data returns through RegData ahead of the FCA due date.
Record the RegData submission receipt reference alongside the NAIC/state confirmations for group-level tracking.
checklist.done: the UK RegData returns are submitted on schedule and their receipts are logged with the group filing evidence.

checklist.step: Retain the filed statement package for the retention period
actions: Assemble the final filed statement, supplements, Jurat page, actuarial sign-off, confirmations and fee receipts into a single filing package.
Apply the 7-year retention label in the compliance evidence repository, indexed by entity, state and period.
Confirm the package is retrievable by entity name and NAIC company code.
checklist.done: the complete filing package is retained for 7 years and retrievable by entity and NAIC company code.

testing.step: Build the population of statements due in the period
actions: Extract from the filing calendar every Annual/Quarterly Statement and state supplemental due in the period across entities.
Reconcile the count to the entity/state license list.
Resolve any difference before sampling.
testing.done: the population is reconciled to the license list and signed complete.

testing.step: Reconcile each population row to a filed submission
actions: Match each due filing to a submission confirmation number and date.
Compare the submission date to the statutory due date.
List unmatched or late rows as automatic exceptions.
testing.done: every row is matched to a confirmation or logged as an exception.

testing.step: Select the test sample
actions: Take 100% of Annual Statement filings.
Take 20 Quarterly filings at random (seeded), minimum 25 rows total.
Record the seed and population size in the workpaper.
testing.done: the sample is drawn, reproducible, and covers all Annual filings.

testing.step: Re-verify the submission in the NAIC and state systems
actions: Log into the NAIC Financial Data Repository and the state DOI portal for each sampled row.
Confirm the filing exists, the status is Accepted, and the submission date matches the workpaper.
Screenshot the confirmation screen into the workpaper.
testing.done: each sampled row is independently confirmed accepted with a captured screenshot.

testing.step: Recompute the statutory deadline for each sampled row
actions: Recompute the due date from the NAIC Annual Statement Instructions or state statute (March 1 annual, 45 days quarterly).
Compare to the actual submission date.
Flag any late filing without a documented extension.
testing.done: no sampled filing is late without a documented, approved extension.

testing.step: Verify CFO certification and Appointed Actuary sign-off pre-dated submission
actions: Pull the signed Jurat page and actuarial review note for each sampled row.
Confirm signature dates are before the submission timestamp.
Flag any filing submitted before sign-off was obtained.
testing.done: every sampled filing has a pre-dated CFO certification and actuarial sign-off.

testing.step: Trace fee payment for each sampled row
actions: Match the OPTins/state payment confirmation to the sampled filing.
Confirm the fee amount agrees with the state's published fee schedule.
Flag unpaid or short-paid fees.
testing.done: fee payment traces and agrees with the fee schedule for every sampled row.

testing.step: Test amended filings for correct re-certification
actions: For any amendment in the sample period, confirm it went through CFO re-certification and Controller review before resubmission.
Confirm the new confirmation number is on file.
testing.done: every amendment is re-certified and carries its own confirmation number.

testing.step: Log every exception with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise a tracker issue per exception with the entity, state and what was missed.
Assign root cause (data error, missed deadline, wrong state form) and an owner.
Set a remediation date and carry open items into the next quarter's retest.
testing.done: every exception has an issue, a root cause, an owner and a remediation date.

testing.step: Conclude, sign and report the test
actions: Compute the exception rate against the zero-tolerance threshold.
Write the conclusion with the evidence references behind it.
Have the independent reviewer sign the workpaper.
Report results to the Compliance Committee and file the workpaper in the evidence repository.
testing.done: a signed workpaper with a stated conclusion and committee reporting date exists in the repository.

Accountable obligation owner.value: Owns completeness and accuracy of every NAIC Annual Statement supplemental schedule and exhibit across writing entities; escalates unresolved schedule gaps to the CFO

Citation verified against current regula.value: Yes — current-year NAIC Annual Statement Instructions (Schedule F, P, D, Y; RBC Instructions; ORSA Guidance Manual), re-read at the start of each Annual Statement cycle

In-scope processes.value: Annual Statement supplemental schedule and exhibit preparation for every NAIC-licensed writing entity: Schedule F (reinsurance), Schedule P (loss reserves), Schedule D (investments), Schedule Y (holding company), Risk-Based Capital, and the ORSA Summary Report

In-scope systems.value: Statutory reporting system for schedule population; ceded accounting platform for Schedule F; reserving system for Schedule P; investment system for Schedule D

Compliance procedure documented.value: Supplemental Schedule Preparation Procedure — preparer assignment per schedule, data source mapping, cross-foot tie-out, review chain

Compliance procedure approved.value: Approved by Controller; reviewed annually ahead of the Annual Statement cycle and on any NAIC Instruction change

Filing/reporting deadlines tracked.value: All schedules and exhibits due with the March 1 Annual Statement; RBC report due concurrently; ORSA Summary Report due per the group's board-set annual date

Deadline reminders configured.value: Schedule-level milestones at T-45/T-21/T-7 days ahead of the March 1 filing to allow sequential preparer/reviewer sign-off

Evidence retained per the retention requ.value: Completed schedules, source data extracts and reviewer sign-offs retained 7 years in the compliance evidence repository

Violations/exceptions logged with dispos.value: Any schedule that fails to tie or is filed incomplete is logged with root cause and corrective action

Remediation sign-off captured.value: Controller signs off any schedule correction or restatement before resubmission

Test population (in-scope transactions,.value: Every required supplemental schedule and exhibit filed with the Annual Statement for each writing entity in the year under test

Pass/fail thresholds.value: Zero tolerance for a schedule that does not cross-foot to the Annual Statement page totals or is missing from the filed package

Compliance test frequency matched to the.value: Tested annually, immediately after the March 1 filing

Independent reviewer (segregated from th.value: Reviewer independent of the schedule preparers

Evidence location for test results.value: Annual schedule-tie-out workpaper in the compliance evidence repository

Regulator-ready documentation.value: Schedule package with source-data reconciliation, producible for a financial exam within 5 business days

Regulator response path.value: Controller owns the financial-exam response; Reserving Actuary and Reinsurance Accountant support schedule-specific questions

checklist.step: Build the schedule and exhibit requirement list per entity
actions: Pull the current NAIC Annual Statement Instructions table of required schedules for the entity's blank type (Life/P&C/Health).
Cross-check against last year's filed package.
Note any new schedule required by an Instruction change.
Assign each schedule a preparer and a reviewer.
checklist.done: the requirement list is complete with a preparer/reviewer assigned per schedule.

checklist.step: Prepare Schedule F — reinsurance ceded and assumed
actions: Extract ceded/assumed premium, loss and reserve balances by reinsurer from the ceded accounting platform.
Populate Schedule F Parts 1-9, including the overdue reinsurance and provision for reinsurance calculation.
Reconcile Schedule F totals to the ceded reinsurance balances on the Assets/Liabilities pages.
Flag any unauthorized/unrated reinsurer requiring collateral.
checklist.done: Schedule F is populated, ties to the balance sheet, and unauthorized-reinsurer collateral is confirmed.

checklist.step: Prepare Schedule P — loss and loss adjustment expense reserves
actions: Export accident-year triangles from the reserving system.
Populate Schedule P Parts 1-4 with paid/incurred loss, LAE and reserve development by line of business.
Tie Schedule P Part 1 reserve totals to the liabilities page.
Document any methodology change from the prior year.
checklist.done: Schedule P triangles tie to the liabilities page and any methodology change is documented.

checklist.step: Prepare Schedule D — investment holdings
actions: Extract security-level holdings and NAIC designations from the investment accounting system.
Populate Schedule D Parts 1-6 by CUSIP with book/adjusted carrying value and fair value.
Tie the schedule's total admitted asset value to the Assets page.
checklist.done: Schedule D ties by CUSIP count and total value to the Assets page.

checklist.step: Prepare Schedule Y — holding company organizational chart and transactions
actions: Update the organizational chart from the current entity registry.
List intercompany agreements and transactions per Part 2.
Confirm every material intercompany transaction has the required Form D prior notice on file.
checklist.done: Schedule Y's chart is current and every listed transaction has a Form D notice on file where required.

checklist.step: Compute and file the Risk-Based Capital report
actions: Run the RBC calculation in the statutory reporting system using the tied-out Annual Statement data.
Confirm the RBC ratio against the Company Action Level, Regulatory Action Level and Authorized Control Level trend test thresholds.
Obtain certification of the RBC report.
checklist.done: the RBC report is calculated, trend-tested and certified.

checklist.step: Draft the ORSA Summary Report
actions: Assemble the risk assessment, capital adequacy and prospective solvency sections per the NAIC ORSA Guidance Manual.
Incorporate the current risk appetite statement and stress-test results.
Route the draft to the CFO for input.
checklist.done: the ORSA draft is assembled with all three required sections and cross-functional input incorporated.

checklist.step: Perform the schedule-to-page cross-foot review
actions: For each schedule, verify its control totals agree exactly with the corresponding Annual Statement page line.
Document any tie-out break and its resolution.
Sign off each schedule as tied.
checklist.done: every schedule ties to its Annual Statement page line with no unresolved break.

checklist.step: Route schedules through second-level technical review
actions: Independently re-foot a sample of schedule totals.
Confirm prior-year comparative columns are correctly rolled forward.
Confirm notes to schedules (such as the Schedule F overdue reinsurance narrative) are complete.
checklist.done: second-level review is complete with no open re-foot discrepancies.

checklist.step: Obtain Board Audit Committee awareness of the ORSA Summary Report
actions: Post the ORSA Summary Report to the board portal ahead of the Audit Committee meeting.
Brief the committee on key risk and capital findings.
Record committee acknowledgement in the minutes.
checklist.done: Audit Committee acknowledgement of the ORSA Summary Report is recorded in the minutes.

checklist.step: Assemble the full supplemental package for filing
actions: Compile all completed, signed-off schedules and the RBC report into the Annual Statement filing package.
Confirm page numbering and cross-references match the main blank.
Hand off the package to the Regulatory Reporting Manager for submission.
checklist.done: a complete, cross-referenced supplemental package is ready for submission.

checklist.step: Retain schedule source-data extracts alongside the filed schedules
actions: Save the source extracts (ceded accounting export, reserving triangles, investment holdings extract) used to populate each schedule.
Link each extract to its schedule in the evidence repository.
Label with the 7-year retention tag.
checklist.done: every schedule's source extract is retained and linked in the evidence repository.

checklist.step: Log and remediate any schedule prepared late or with an unresolved tie-out break
actions: Raise an issue for any schedule missing its internal preparation deadline or filed with an unresolved break.
Assign root cause and a corrective-action owner.
Track to closure before the next cycle.
checklist.done: every late or broken schedule has a logged, owned corrective action.

checklist.step: Brief the Appointed Actuary and CFO on schedule interdependencies before sign-off
actions: Walk the CFO and Appointed Actuary through how Schedule P reserve changes flow into RBC and the ORSA capital projection.
Confirm no inconsistency between the reserve figures used across schedules.
checklist.done: reserve and capital figures are confirmed consistent across Schedule P, RBC and ORSA before sign-off.

checklist.step: File the finalized schedule package for the retention period
actions: Archive the finalized, filed schedule package with all sign-offs.
Apply the 7-year retention label indexed by entity and Annual Statement year.
Confirm retrievability.
checklist.done: the finalized schedule package is retained 7 years and retrievable by entity and year.

testing.step: Build the population of required schedules for the year under test
actions: Pull the NAIC Instructions requirement list for each entity's blank type.
Compare to the filed package's table of contents.
List any missing schedule as an automatic exception.
testing.done: the population of required schedules is reconciled to the filed table of contents.

testing.step: Re-foot each sampled schedule's control totals
actions: Independently re-sum a sample of schedules.
Compare to the filed totals and to the corresponding Annual Statement page line.
Log any discrepancy.
testing.done: sampled schedule totals are independently re-footed and tied, or the discrepancy is logged.

testing.step: Select the schedule sample
actions: Take Schedule F, Schedule P and RBC for 100% of entities.
Take a random sample of the remaining schedules across entities, minimum 15.
Record the seed and the population size.
testing.done: the sample covers all high-risk schedules and a documented random selection of the rest.

testing.step: Trace Schedule F reinsurance balances to reinsurer confirmations
actions: Pull a sample of Schedule F reinsurer balances.
Request or pull the corresponding reinsurer confirmation/statement.
Compare balances and flag any unconfirmed or disputed amount.
testing.done: sampled reinsurer balances agree with confirmations, or the difference is logged.

testing.step: Recompute the RBC ratio independently
actions: Rebuild the RBC calculation from the filed Annual Statement data using the current RBC Instructions formula.
Compare the recomputed ratio to the filed ratio and the action-level trigger.
Flag any variance beyond rounding.
testing.done: the independently recomputed RBC ratio agrees with the filed ratio within rounding tolerance.

testing.step: Verify Schedule P reserve development against the reserving system
actions: Compare the filed Schedule P triangles to the current reserving system output as of the same evaluation date.
Confirm no unexplained restatement of a prior accident year.
testing.done: Schedule P triangles agree with the reserving system, or restatements are explained and documented.

testing.step: Confirm the ORSA Summary Report reached the Audit Committee before filing
actions: Pull the board portal record and Audit Committee minutes.
Confirm the ORSA report was presented and acknowledged before the Annual Statement filing date.
testing.done: Audit Committee acknowledgement of the ORSA report is dated before the filing.

testing.step: Verify sign-off completeness for every sampled schedule
actions: Confirm each sampled schedule carries preparer, Controller tie-out and second-level review sign-offs with dates preceding submission.
testing.done: every sampled schedule has all three sign-offs dated before submission.

testing.step: Log every exception with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise an issue per exception.
Assign root cause and owner.
Set remediation date.
Carry open items into next year's retest.
testing.done: every exception has an issue, root cause, owner and remediation date.

testing.step: Conclude, sign and report the test
actions: Compute the exception rate.
Write the conclusion.
Have an independent reviewer sign.
Report to the Audit Committee and file the workpaper.
testing.done: a signed workpaper with a conclusion is filed and reported to the Audit Committee.

Accountable obligation owner.value: Owns the statutory audit engagement and the June 1 filing of CPA-audited financial statements for every entity required under the NAIC Model Audit Rule

Citation verified against current regula.value: Yes — NAIC Annual Financial Reporting Model Regulation (Model Audit Rule, #205) and the domiciliary state's audit filing statute, re-read ahead of each audit cycle

In-scope processes.value: External audit engagement, PBC delivery, fieldwork support, Management's Report of Internal Control over Financial Reporting (MRIC), and filing of the audited statutory financial statements and audit opinion

In-scope systems.value: General ledger and statutory reporting system for PBC extracts; compliance evidence repository for the audit report and MRIC

Compliance procedure documented.value: Statutory Audit Coordination Procedure — engagement letter, PBC list, fieldwork logistics, MRIC preparation, opinion review, filing

Compliance procedure approved.value: Approved by the Audit Committee and CFO; reviewed annually before the audit kickoff

Filing/reporting deadlines tracked.value: Audited statutory financial statements and audit opinion due June 1 to the domiciliary state and NAIC; MRIC due with the audited financials

Deadline reminders configured.value: Milestone alerts at engagement letter execution, PBC delivery, fieldwork start, draft opinion, and T-14/T-3 days to the June 1 filing

Evidence retained per the retention requ.value: Signed engagement letter, PBC package, management representation letter, audit opinion and MRIC retained 7 years

Violations/exceptions logged with dispos.value: Any audit delay risking the June 1 deadline is logged with cause and an extension request tracked

Remediation sign-off captured.value: CFO signs off any audit finding remediation plan and any extension request to the domiciliary regulator

Test population (in-scope transactions,.value: The audited statutory financial statement filing for every entity required to file under the Model Audit Rule in the year under test

Pass/fail thresholds.value: Zero tolerance for a June 1 filing miss without an approved extension; any unqualified-opinion expectation that becomes qualified triggers escalation

Compliance test frequency matched to the.value: Tested annually after the June 1 filing

Independent reviewer (segregated from th.value: Reviewer independent of the audit-coordination team

Evidence location for test results.value: Annual audit-filing test workpaper in the compliance evidence repository

Regulator-ready documentation.value: Engagement letter, opinion letter and filing confirmation, producible for a financial exam within 5 business days

Regulator response path.value: Controller owns the regulator response; General Counsel reviews any correspondence referencing an audit finding

checklist.step: Confirm audit scope and re-execute the engagement letter
actions: Confirm which entities require a Model Audit Rule audit for the year.
Review the external auditor's engagement letter for scope, fee and timeline changes.
Route to the Audit Committee Chair for signature.
File the countersigned letter.
checklist.done: the engagement letter is signed and filed before fieldwork planning begins.

checklist.step: Build and deliver the PBC (prepared-by-client) list
actions: Pull the auditor's PBC request list from the prior year and update it for current-year changes.
Extract trial balances, reserve workpapers and investment schedules from the general ledger and statutory reporting system.
Deliver the PBC package to the auditor's secure portal by the agreed date.
checklist.done: the complete PBC package is delivered to the auditor by the agreed date.

checklist.step: Coordinate fieldwork logistics and access
actions: Schedule fieldwork dates with the auditor and relevant process owners (Reserving Actuary, Reinsurance Accountant, Investment Analyst).
Provision temporary read access to the general ledger and statutory reporting system for the audit team.
Confirm confidentiality agreements are on file.
checklist.done: fieldwork is scheduled, access is provisioned, and confidentiality agreements are on file.

checklist.step: Support audit sample requests and walkthroughs
actions: Respond to auditor sample-item requests (invoices, reinsurance confirmations, investment trade tickets) within the agreed turnaround.
Walk the auditor through key controls (reserve review, investment valuation, reinsurance recoverable) on request.
checklist.done: every sample request is fulfilled within the agreed turnaround and walkthroughs are completed.

checklist.step: Prepare the Management's Report of Internal Control over Financial Reporting
actions: Assess the design and operating effectiveness of key controls over statutory financial reporting for the year.
Document any control deficiency and its remediation status.
Draft the MRIC per the Model Audit Rule template.
checklist.done: the MRIC is drafted, covering control assessment and any deficiency remediation status.

checklist.step: Route audit findings for management response
actions: Log each audit finding or proposed adjustment from the auditor.
Obtain the responsible process owner's root-cause explanation and corrective action.
Agree the disposition (booked, waived, disclosed) with the auditor.
checklist.done: every finding has a documented management response and agreed disposition.

checklist.step: Obtain and review the draft management representation letter
actions: Review the auditor's draft management representation letter against the year's known issues and subsequent events.
Confirm no material misstatement is knowingly omitted.
Sign the letter ahead of opinion issuance.
checklist.done: the CFO has reviewed and signed the management representation letter.

checklist.step: Review the draft audit opinion and financial statements
actions: Compare the auditor's draft opinion and statutory financial statements to the filed Annual Statement for consistency.
Confirm the opinion type (unqualified/qualified).
Flag any unexpected qualification to the Audit Committee immediately.
checklist.done: the draft opinion and statements are reviewed, reconciled to the Annual Statement, and any qualification is escalated.

checklist.step: Present audit results to the Audit Committee
actions: Post the draft opinion, MRIC and significant findings to the board portal ahead of the Audit Committee meeting.
Present the results and the management representation letter.
Record the committee's acceptance in the minutes.
checklist.done: Audit Committee acceptance of the audit results is recorded in the minutes.

checklist.step: Finalize and obtain the signed audit opinion
actions: Confirm the auditor has issued the final signed opinion letter on firm letterhead.
Verify the opinion date, entity name and reporting period are correct.
File the signed original.
checklist.done: a signed, correctly dated audit opinion is on file.

checklist.step: File the audited financial statements and MRIC with the domiciliary state and NAIC
actions: Upload the audited financial statements, audit opinion and MRIC to the NAIC Financial Data Repository and the domiciliary state's portal.
Submit copies to any non-domiciliary state requiring direct filing.
Record confirmation numbers.
checklist.done: the audited financials, opinion and MRIC are filed with the NAIC and domiciliary state, confirmation numbers on file.

checklist.step: Confirm the June 1 deadline was met or request an extension
actions: Compare the filing date to the June 1 statutory deadline.
Where a delay is unavoidable, submit a written extension request to the domiciliary state before the deadline and track its approval.
checklist.done: the filing is confirmed on time, or an approved extension is on file before June 1.

checklist.step: Close out control deficiencies identified in the MRIC
actions: Open a remediation issue for each control deficiency disclosed in the MRIC.
Assign an owner and a target closure date.
Track progress to the next audit cycle.
checklist.done: every disclosed deficiency has an owned remediation issue with a target date.

checklist.step: Brief the Board on the audit outcome
actions: Summarize the audit opinion, any qualification, and MRIC deficiencies for the full Board.
Post the summary to the board portal.
Record Board notation in the minutes.
checklist.done: full Board notation of the audit outcome is recorded in the minutes.

checklist.step: Retain the complete audit file for the retention period
actions: Assemble the engagement letter, PBC package, findings log, representation letter, MRIC, opinion and filing confirmations.
Apply the 7-year retention label indexed by entity and audit year.
Confirm retrievability.
checklist.done: the complete audit file is retained 7 years and retrievable by entity and year.

testing.step: Build the population of entities required to file an audited statement
actions: Pull the list of entities meeting the Model Audit Rule audit threshold for the year.
Compare to the list actually filed.
List any missing entity as an exception.
testing.done: the population is reconciled to entities meeting the audit requirement.

testing.step: Reconcile the filing date to the June 1 deadline
actions: Compare each entity's audited statement filing date to June 1.
Where late, confirm an approved extension is on file.
Flag any late filing without one.
testing.done: every entity filed on time or with an approved extension on file.

testing.step: Select the sample
actions: Take 100% of entities that received a qualified opinion or disclosed an MRIC deficiency.
Take a random sample of the remainder, minimum 5.
Record the seed.
testing.done: the sample covers all qualified opinions/deficiencies plus a documented random selection.

testing.step: Verify the audit opinion authenticity and terms
actions: Confirm the filed opinion is on the auditor's letterhead, correctly dated and signed, and matches the auditor's engagement letter scope.
Contact the audit firm to confirm issuance if in doubt.
testing.done: each sampled opinion is confirmed authentic and matches the engagement scope.

testing.step: Trace management representation letter timing
actions: Confirm the CFO's signed representation letter pre-dates the audit opinion issuance date for each sampled entity.
testing.done: the representation letter is dated before the opinion for every sampled entity.

testing.step: Verify MRIC deficiency remediation tracking
actions: Pull each disclosed MRIC deficiency.
Confirm a remediation issue exists with an owner and target date.
Check prior-year deficiencies for closure status.
testing.done: every deficiency has a tracked remediation and prior-year items show closure or a documented reason for carry-forward.

testing.step: Confirm Audit Committee acceptance pre-dated filing
actions: Pull the Audit Committee minutes and board portal record.
Confirm acceptance of the audit results is dated before the statement was filed.
testing.done: the Audit Committee acceptance date precedes the filing date.

testing.step: Reconcile the filed audited financials to the Annual Statement
actions: Compare key totals (surplus, net income, admitted assets) on the audited financial statements to the corresponding Annual Statement figures.
Investigate any difference.
testing.done: the audited financials agree with the Annual Statement, or the difference is explained.

testing.step: Log every exception with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise an issue per exception.
Assign root cause and owner.
Set remediation date.
Carry open items forward.
testing.done: every exception has an issue, root cause, owner and remediation date.

testing.step: Conclude, sign and report the test
actions: Compute the exception rate.
Write the conclusion.
Have the independent reviewer sign.
Report to the Audit Committee and file the workpaper.
testing.done: a signed workpaper with a stated conclusion is filed and reported.

Accountable obligation owner.value: Owns the master multi-jurisdiction filing calendar covering every NAIC/state, FCA and other regulator obligation for the group

Citation verified against current regula.value: Yes — NAIC Annual Statement Instructions due-date table, each state DOI's filing-deadline statute, and FCA Handbook SUP 16 reporting schedule, re-verified each time a regulator publishes a due-date change

In-scope processes.value: End-to-end filing-deadline tracking for statutory statements, supplemental schedules, audit filings, MCAS, license renewals and FCA/RegData returns across all licensed jurisdictions

In-scope systems.value: Central filing calendar and issue tracker; cross-referenced to the statutory reporting system and the RegData submission log

Compliance procedure documented.value: Filing Calendar Maintenance Procedure — source list of obligations, deadline capture, reminder configuration, timeliness evidence capture

Compliance procedure approved.value: Approved by the Regulatory Reporting Manager and Controller; reviewed quarterly

Filing/reporting deadlines tracked.value: Every statutory, audit, MCAS, license renewal and FCA return deadline across all in-scope jurisdictions, refreshed each time a regulator publishes a schedule

Deadline reminders configured.value: Automated T-30/T-14/T-3 day reminders to the named filing owner for every calendar entry

Evidence retained per the retention requ.value: Calendar snapshots and timeliness evidence (submission vs. due date) retained 7 years

Violations/exceptions logged with dispos.value: Any calendar entry missed or filed late is logged as an exception with cause and owner

Remediation sign-off captured.value: Manager signs off calendar corrections and any missed-deadline remediation

Test population (in-scope transactions,.value: Every filing-calendar entry due in the period across all tracked jurisdictions

Pass/fail thresholds.value: Any calendar entry with no linked evidence of on-time completion is a fail

Compliance test frequency matched to the.value: Tested quarterly against that quarter's due entries

Independent reviewer (segregated from th.value: Reviewer independent of the filing calendar owner

Evidence location for test results.value: Quarterly filing-calendar completeness workpaper in the compliance evidence repository

Regulator-ready documentation.value: Calendar extract with linked confirmations, producible within 5 business days

Regulator response path.value: Regulatory Reporting Manager owns the response; Regulatory Counsel clears any correspondence

checklist.step: Build the master obligation source list
actions: Compile every recurring regulatory obligation (NAIC statements, state supplements, audit filings, MCAS, license renewals, FCA returns) from the prior year's calendar and each regulator's current instructions.
Confirm no obligation was dropped when an entity added a new license.
checklist.done: the master obligation source list is complete and cross-checked against current licenses.

checklist.step: Capture each obligation's statutory due date and computation rule
actions: Record the exact due-date rule for each obligation (fixed date, days-after-period-end, days-after-fiscal-year-end).
Cite the statute, NAIC instruction or FCA Handbook rule behind each rule.
checklist.done: every obligation has a cited due-date rule.

checklist.step: Load obligations into the filing calendar system
actions: Create a calendar entry per obligation per entity/jurisdiction with owner, due-date rule and evidence-artifact type.
Link each entry to the relevant statutory citation.
checklist.done: every obligation is loaded with an owner and evidence-artifact type.

checklist.step: Configure automated reminders
actions: Set T-30/T-14/T-3 day reminder rules against every entry's computed due date.
Route reminders to the named filing owner and the Regulatory Reporting Manager as a cc.
checklist.done: reminders are configured and confirmed firing on a test entry.

checklist.step: Reconcile the calendar to the entity/license register each quarter
actions: Compare the calendar's jurisdiction list to the current license/registration register.
Add obligations for any newly licensed jurisdiction and retire obligations for withdrawn licenses.
checklist.done: the calendar jurisdiction list matches the current license register.

checklist.step: Capture timeliness evidence as each obligation closes
actions: As each filing is submitted, attach the confirmation number and submission date to its calendar entry.
Mark the entry Complete only once evidence is attached.
checklist.done: every closed-period entry carries attached evidence and a Complete status.

checklist.step: Review upcoming-quarter obligations at the monthly filing-calendar meeting
actions: Convene process owners monthly to review obligations due in the next 60 days.
Confirm each owner is aware and on track.
Escalate any at-risk item.
checklist.done: the monthly review is held with documented attendance and at-risk items escalated.

checklist.step: Escalate at-risk deadlines
actions: For any entry flagged at-risk, notify the Controller and, for FCA obligations, the Regulatory Affairs Manager.
Document the mitigation plan on the entry.
checklist.done: every at-risk entry has a documented mitigation plan and named escalation contact.

checklist.step: Track FCA/UK obligations alongside US obligations
actions: Maintain the RegData submission schedule under SUP 16 and PRA reporting dates in the same calendar.
Confirm consistency of reminder cadence with the US entries.
checklist.done: FCA/UK obligations are tracked in the same calendar with matching reminder cadence.

checklist.step: Log any missed or late deadline as an exception immediately
actions: The moment a due date passes without Complete status, auto-generate an exception ticket.
Assign root cause and an owner within one business day.
checklist.done: every missed deadline generates a same-day exception ticket with an assigned owner.

checklist.step: Reconcile the calendar to actual filings quarterly
actions: Independently pull the list of filings actually made from the statutory reporting system and RegData log.
Compare to calendar Complete entries.
Investigate any mismatch.
checklist.done: calendar Complete status reconciles to actual filings made.

checklist.step: Publish the quarterly filing timeliness scorecard
actions: Build a scorecard of on-time vs. late filings by entity and jurisdiction.
Distribute to the Controller and Head of Compliance.
checklist.done: the quarterly scorecard is published and distributed.

checklist.step: Update the calendar for any regulator-announced deadline change
actions: Monitor NAIC and FCA bulletins for due-date changes.
Update the affected calendar entries and re-arm reminders within 5 business days of the announcement.
checklist.done: any announced deadline change is reflected in the calendar within 5 business days.

checklist.step: Review and refresh the calendar procedure annually
actions: Review the Filing Calendar Maintenance Procedure against the year's exceptions and near-misses.
Update reminder cadence or ownership assignments as needed.
Route for Controller approval.
checklist.done: the procedure is reviewed, updated where needed, and re-approved annually.

checklist.step: Retain calendar snapshots and timeliness evidence
actions: Archive a quarterly snapshot of the full calendar with linked evidence.
Apply the 7-year retention label.
Confirm retrievability by jurisdiction and period.
checklist.done: quarterly calendar snapshots are retained 7 years and retrievable by jurisdiction.

testing.step: Build the population of calendar entries due in the quarter
actions: Export every entry with a due date in the quarter across all jurisdictions.
Reconcile the count to the license register.
testing.done: the population is reconciled to the license register.

testing.step: Reconcile calendar Complete status to actual filings
actions: Independently pull filings made from the statutory reporting system and RegData log.
Match to calendar entries marked Complete.
List mismatches as exceptions.
testing.done: every Complete entry is matched to an actual filing, or logged as an exception.

testing.step: Select the sample
actions: Take 100% of entries flagged at-risk or exception during the quarter.
Take a random sample of the remainder, minimum 20.
Record the seed.
testing.done: the sample covers all at-risk/exception entries plus a documented random selection.

testing.step: Verify evidence attachment on sampled entries
actions: Open each sampled entry and confirm a confirmation number and submission-date evidence file is attached and legible.
testing.done: every sampled entry has legible, attached evidence.

testing.step: Recompute the due date for sampled entries
actions: Independently recompute the due date from the cited statute/instruction.
Compare to the calendar's stated due date.
Flag any miscalculation.
testing.done: recomputed due dates agree with the calendar, or the difference is logged.

testing.step: Confirm reminder delivery for sampled entries
actions: Pull the reminder system log and confirm T-30/T-14/T-3 reminders actually fired to the named owner for each sampled entry.
testing.done: reminder delivery is confirmed for every sampled entry.

testing.step: Test escalation timeliness for at-risk entries
actions: For sampled at-risk entries, confirm escalation to the Controller/Regulatory Affairs Manager occurred within the procedure's stated timeframe.
testing.done: escalation occurred within the procedure's stated timeframe for every sampled at-risk entry.

testing.step: Verify jurisdiction completeness against the license register
actions: Compare the calendar's jurisdiction list to the current license/registration register independently.
Flag any missing jurisdiction.
testing.done: the calendar covers every licensed jurisdiction, or gaps are logged.

testing.step: Log every exception with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise an issue per exception.
Assign root cause and owner.
Set remediation date.
Carry forward open items.
testing.done: every exception has an issue, root cause, owner and remediation date.

testing.step: Conclude, sign and report the test
actions: Compute the exception/miss rate.
Write the conclusion.
Independent reviewer signs.
Report to the Compliance Committee and file the workpaper.
testing.done: a signed workpaper with a stated conclusion is filed and reported.
